attributions.surface_quote: the dualism of the sacred and the secular

attributions.surface_quote: suffering is ideally and aesthetically superior to happiness

attributions.surface_quote: Russian religion and aesthetics flow together from the source.

canonical_statement: The experience of divine presence can render the distinction between heaven and earth indistinguishable.

attributions.surface_quote: we did not know where we were, in heaven or on earth

attributions.surface_quote: Chekhov appears to be hiding some other, more important, unspeakable mystery.

attributions.surface_quote: This world is but a shadow, a companion to true existence.

attributions.surface_quote: A world immersed in evil is actually illusory and could fall apart.

attributions.surface_quote: Without this tense duality between spirit and flesh... culture would not exist.

attributions.surface_quote: Russian Orthodoxy does not allow for real existence and tensely awaits its end.

attributions.surface_quote: This unyielding stance outside of culture sets up the polarity of cultural space itself.

canonical_statement: Reality and consciousness are fundamentally characterized by a drive toward the integration of disparate aspects of being.

attributions.surface_quote: essential drive toward a wholeness of inward and outward being

attributions.surface_quote: Dostoyevsky revealed the polarity of the Russian spirit to be its most profound quality.

canonical_statement: The soul attains divinity through the eradication of all polarities and contradictions.

attributions.surface_quote: In the soul, he finds divinity, all polarities and contradictions are eradicated.

attributions.surface_quote: Events always take place along boundaries, crossing over them.

attributions.surface_quote: The ternary model cannot be reduced either to duality or to a median.

attributions.surface_quote: Life in the neutral zone is dangerous because it leads one to forget boundaries.

attributions.surface_quote: It is important to retain a sense of boundaries to uphold the center.

attributions.surface_quote: Only when the two have their own separate source of power can the third exist.

attributions.surface_quote: The center becomes a single, flat, and convenient abode for stress-free existence.

canonical_statement: The transition from binary to ternary structures can manifest as sudden, explosive shifts rather than gradual evolution.

attributions.surface_quote: We want to realize gradual development by applying explosive technology.

attributions.surface_quote: The frightening possibility of the ternary becoming the medial, a flat unitarian center.

attributions.surface_quote: Russian culture needs to enrich itself with neutral zones and not reject binary models.

canonical_statement: Global historical processes operate through a compensatory mechanism where regional stasis is balanced by the dynamics of another region.

attributions.surface_quote: static in one region is balanced by the dynamics of another

canonical_statement: Cultural and historical evolution is driven by explosive, paradoxical, and semiotic upheavals rather than linear progression.

attributions.surface_quote: explosive model with all of its demonic, apophatic, grotesque, and tragicomic components

canonical_statement: Nature possesses an inherent soul or consciousness.

attributions.surface_quote: attribute soul to nature

canonical_statement: Human consciousness has the potential to achieve immortality.

attributions.surface_quote: to make man immortal

canonical_statement: The fundamental nature of reality is a dialectical interplay between metaphysical expansion and nominalistic deflation.

attributions.surface_quote: counterweight to metaphysical radicalism will be conceptual game-playing

attributions.surface_quote: These extremes cannot be eliminated... cannot be eradicated from the culture.

canonical_statement: Excessive intimacy between individuals inherently leads to hatred.

attributions.surface_quote: excessive intimacy which leads to hatred.

attributions.surface_quote: The merging of heaven and earth looming on the eschatological horizon.

canonical_statement: Reality and cultural evolution are structured by ternary systems rather than binary oppositions.

attributions.surface_quote: The change from a binary system to a ternary.

attributions.surface_quote: Flattening them with smooth asphalt into a uniform, seamless middle way.

attributions.surface_quote: Retain a sense of the edges, to take along a sense of the crossroads.

attributions.surface_quote: the crossroads will always be drawing closer, representing the necessity and the futility of choice.

canonical_statement: Extreme states of being can manifest simultaneously within a single identity.

attributions.surface_quote: expressing baseness and saintliness at their maximal levels.

canonical_statement: Self-awareness of one's own nature as a parody leads to the dissolution of the self.

attributions.surface_quote: a parody which becomes aware of itself as such disappears

attributions.surface_quote: The chain of parodies continues into infinity... It reaches the Absolute

attributions.surface_quote: Every decision is taken to a metaphysical extreme and therefore contains the mechanism of its own derangement.

canonical_statement: The essence of a crossroads is defined by its perpetual state of suspension and non-resolution.

attributions.surface_quote: it wants to remain a crossroads, continue as a crossroads.

attributions.surface_quote: the third way will not be a detour but will rather produce a further deepening

attributions.surface_quote: Annensky is the only human being among these super-human and inhuman creatures.

attributions.surface_quote: The link between genius and the sudden moment is keenly felt.

attributions.surface_quote: the apophatic tradition of the Orthodox Church

attributions.surface_quote: seek a positive embodiment of the ideal

canonical_statement: The boundary between the secular/social and the religious/moral is permeable.

attributions.surface_quote: We do not know how to tell of this.

attributions.surface_quote: Outerness is the most powerful lever for understanding.

attributions.surface_quote: Both are based on the binary opposition of values and do not admit of a middle ground.

canonical_statement: A ternary model of reality can integrate extreme polarities through a symbiotic intermediate state.
